Seiryu Combat Achievements

​
Introduction
This guide will go over how to complete the Combat achievements for Seiryu, and assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of the encounter which can be found in #ed1-basic.
​
Presets and Relics
⬥ Range Melee Hybrid
⬥ Melee Camp

Ranged-Melee Hybrid Seiryu Grandmaster Speed Killer
⬥ This rotation is NOT recommended for standard kills, only for the achievement

⬥ With this rotation it is possible to hit ~0:39.0 kill times
